prompt.en: Which part of the original Parliament Buildings is still standing?
prompt.fr: Quelle partie des édifices du Parlement d'origine subsiste encore?

explanation.en: The Library is the only piece of the first building left. The rest of the Centre Block dates from the work done after the 1916 fire.
explanation.fr: La Bibliothèque est la seule partie du premier édifice qui subsiste. Le reste de l'édifice du Centre date des travaux réalisés après l'incendie de 1916.

source.quote: The Centre Block was destroyed by an accidental fire in 1916 and rebuilt in 1922. The Library is the only part of the original building remaining.

verification.evidence: The Centre Block was destroyed by an accidental fire in 1916 and rebuilt in 1922. The Library is the only part of the original building remaining.
